body_text:
For a homomorphism $\varphi:G\to H$, the kernel is
$\ker\varphi=\{g\in G:\varphi(g)=e_H\}$ and the image is
$\operatorname{im}\varphi=\{\varphi(g):g\in G\}$. The kernel is
a normal subgroup of $G$, the image is a subgroup of $H$, and
$\varphi$ is injective exactly when its kernel is trivial.
